final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), above_average AS (SELECT film_count FROM rating_counts WHERE film_count > (SELECT AVG(film_count) FROM rating_counts)) SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total_films, AVG(film_count - (SELECT AVG(film_count) FROM rating_counts)) AS avg_excess FROM above_average
